text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah—
choice_data_list: Good morning, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
I'm going to start walking now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: You're really fine... just following along behind me?
choice_data_list: Yeah, lead the way!

text_block_list.text:
With that, Believe set off.
She walked steadily, arriving first at the town—
And then, suddenly, she stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: (Is she... looking at something?)

text_block_list.text:
She started walking again, reaching the shopping district near the academy.
...There, Believe repeated the exact same gesture.
choice_data_list: (She stops abruptly...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: (And she's definitely looking at something. ...What is it?)

text_block_list.text: Our strange journey continued in silence. As time passed leisurely at a walking pace, I gazed at her back swaying ahead of me.

And finally... just as my legs were starting to feel heavy,
no, extremely heavy, it finally dawned on me—

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: F-Famous buildings, right?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Um, you look exhausted. ...Are you okay?

Waving my hand to show I was fine, I put my theory into words.
What Believe had been stopping to gaze at was—
choice_data_list: Do you like sightseeing spots and landmark buildings?
Do you like sightseeing spots and landmark buildings?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly.
None of these are that sort of thing either.
choice_data_list: (I was way off...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...They're just—buildings that have endured.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
From long ago.
Enduring the wind, the rain... and the harshness of time, remaining right here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Inside things like that...
the work of craftsmen still lives on.
choice_data_list: Craftsmanship—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Built to withstand anything, no matter what happens.
Built to fulfill their intended role to the absolute fullest, endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Through thoroughly forged fundamentals and refined technique,
flawlessly brought to completion... It's first-rate craft.
choice_data_list: So... that's what you were looking at.
So... that's what you were looking at.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: May I ask why?

text_block_list.text:
Believe fell silent.
It took a long, long time before she spoke again.
Even so, I stood beside her, quietly gazing at the weathered old building together, waiting, waiting, and waiting. Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...First-rate craftsmanship...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Brings me back to where it all began.
To my roots.
choice_data_list: Your roots?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...My grandfather.
He was a skilled plasterer, and—

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The brick house... it's already done.
It's so... so pretty.)

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...You came by again today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...Heading to the next job. ...Wanna come?

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yeah!
I wanna watch. ...Grandpa's work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...I remember. My inspiration. My roots.
A quiet, solemn, dignified back... that I gazed up at in wordless awe.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The gentle breeze drifting in from the veranda. A tiny, well-worn TV.
The sweet scent of the pear Grandma sliced for us.)

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa.
...Are you watching the races again today?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Aye. ...Wanna watch too?

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Which one do you think will win?
Hey, Grandpa?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Well—the fastest one is best.

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text: The fastest...

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Aye. ...Just like my craft.
Being the fastest is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I want to do good work too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Just like my grandfather. ...The best, finest work possible.
choice_data_list: ...I see. So that's your—
...I see. So that's your—

text_block_list.text:
This was the precious foundation of who Believe was.
A profound realization clicked into place, connecting everything that had happened so far.

Her sense of duty when fixing that furnace all by herself.
The way she tersely said, "I want to get faster; that's what matters most."

And above all else—
her utterly earnest devotion to what she considers "craft"—
choice_data_list: Is the reason you silently follow my training regimens...
Is the reason you silently follow my training regimens...

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Because you respect the work we do?
Because you respect the work we do?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I wouldn't call it "respect."
It's not anything that grand—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You do your job properly. I do mine properly.
...I just believe that's how it ought to be.
choice_data_list: I see. ...Thank you for telling me.
I see. ...Thank you for telling me.

text_block_list.text:
Finally understanding her true feelings, a smile naturally formed on my face.
With that in mind... I added, "However—"
choice_data_list: There's just one thing you're misunderstanding.
There's just one thing you're misunderstanding.

text_block_list.text:
A trainer's job isn't merely about "setting the regimen and leaving the running to the trainee."
In other words, she can afford to—
choice_data_list: You're allowed to pull me into your work much more!
You're allowed to pull me into your work much more!

text_block_list.text:
Believe had followed my instructions silently out of respect for a trainer's job.
Yet I now knew that deep down, she held a precious dream of her own.

That was why I wanted to understand her better, and support her along the way.
On the dream road Believe truly wanted to walk.
And to start doing that—
choice_data_list: I'd really like to meet your grandfather sometime.
I'd really like to meet your grandfather sometime.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh...? See my grandpa...?
choice_data_list: I want to meet him and see his craftsmanship in person!
I want to meet him and see his craftsmanship in person!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No... um, that's not really possible.
Grandpa is an incredible craftsman, so...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
His skills were recognized, and right now... he's working over in America.
It'd be hard to go see him...
choice_data_list: ...America...

text_block_list.text:
I flinch for a second, but stand my ground. I already resolved to give her my all.
...Her profile from today, and the fire in her eyes, rush back into my mind.

What did Believe see and yearn for through those earnest eyes as a child?
The heart of that dream is something I have to see for myself!
choice_data_list: Alright! We're going to America to see him!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Wait... what? ...Whaaat...!?
